title: P18-E canonical org_agent_duty — an org_agent's declared objective coverage inside one business
description: P18-E: parity fix on P18-A objective-relation.ts — colon-containing relation endpoints are now rejected at create(), dropped in provenRow (unmintable shape), never projected into index pointers by ensureIndex (a raw colon-endpoint row could otherwise mint a poison key inside an innocent objective's admissionView prefix range and wedge its gate permanently), and typed-failed at admissionView. P18-E proper: new canonical entity org_agent_duty — declares that a specific org_agent's responsibility covers a specific objective set (the staffing fact P18-F recovery/company-E2E consumes to prove a mandate legitimately spans objectives). Multi-lateral authority: actor=operator:<ref> must equal owner_authority_id of EVERY covered objective (the P18-A bilateral rule extended to N). business_id derived from canonical objectives (cross-business sets can never mint); org_agent must resolve and belong to the derived business. Digest pins all canonical fields; OCC on version; event tail re-proved (DUTY_CREATED identity pins incl. objective_ids set + legal STATE hops to row state). provenRow strict/lenient split identical to P18-A: corruption wedges strict write paths and drops per-row on lenient reads; semantic unproven-ness (foreign created_by, amended owner, missing agent, unsorted/duplicate objective_ids, key-borrowed clones) never serves. Reads are O(degree) via dual pointer index (O:{objective}:{duty} + A:{agent}:{duty}, proof-agnostic, resumable chunked rebuild, built-only-when-complete marker) with identical strict global fallback before the marker. coveringDuties(agent, objs) requires ONE proven ACTIVE duty covering the whole set — union-of-duties is deliberately not coverage. INERT: no scheduler/allocation/UI consumer yet — later seams call covers()/coveringDuties(). Codex-only.
